muhammad.summary: Founder of Islam, whose revelations became the Quran and whose community at Medina grew into a polity that unified the Arabian peninsula.

tang-dynasty.summary: A cosmopolitan high point of Chinese poetry, Buddhism and long-distance trade, centred on Chang'an, then the largest city on Earth.

chola-empire.summary: A Tamil maritime empire that projected power to Sri Lanka, the Maldives and Srivijaya, and built the Brihadisvara temple at Thanjavur.
